description: Have each event POSTed to an HTTPS URL the moment it happens, so nothing has to poll. Works with any public HTTPS endpoint; a Discord or Slack "incoming webhook" URL gets a readable chat message instead of JSON. Returns a signing secret ONCE — show it to the user; it verifies the X-Signals-Signature header. Limits: 1 webhook on the free plan (new signals, levels null), 3 on a trial, 5 on a paid plan. Tell the user the URL must be their own private channel or server: signal data may not be redistributed.

apiKey.description: API key — omit if your client was installed with it (X-Api-Key header or ?apiKey=).

events.description: Which events. Default: all your plan includes.

label.description: A name to recognise it by.

minConfidence.description: Only signals at or above this confidence (1–100). Pro.

url.description: Public https:// URL that will receive the POSTs.
